name: Mayumi Yamano
broadcastSummary: The television announcer who was involved in a major scandal. Her silhouette was the first ever captured on the Midnight Channel, setting off the bizarre chain of events in Inaba.

name: Saki Konishi
broadcastSummary: A high school student who discovered Mayumi Yamano's body. Shortly after her silhouette appeared blurry on the screen, she went missing.

name: Yukiko Amagi (Shadow)
broadcastSummary: Appears in a high-fidelity broadcast wearing traditional attire, announcing a reality show to find her 'Prince Charming'. Immediate rescue operation required inside the TV World.

name: Kanji Tatsumi (Shadow)
broadcastSummary: Appears in a flamboyant setting, challenging societal norms and presenting an aggressive, heavily stylized persona broadcast that contradicts his real-world thug reputation.
